title: Tokenized commodities market crosses $6B amid gold’s historic rally
summary: Tether Gold and the Paxos-listed PAX Gold account for over 95% of the tokenized commodities market, which is now outpacing tokenized stocks and funds.

title: Robinhood Q4 earnings miss as crypto revenues decline
summary: Robinhood shares fell nearly 8% in after-hours trading as the platform’s record Q4 revenues weren’t enough to satisfy analysts’ predictions.

title: LayerZero unveils ‘Zero’ chain, with Citadel, ARK backing
summary: Zero is scheduled to launch in the fall of 2026 and LayerZero Labs claims it can scale up to two million transactions per second by leveraging zero-knowledge proofs and Jolt.

title: Ex-SafeMoon chief sentenced to 8 years over $9M investor fraud
summary: SafeMoon’s former chief technology officer, Thomas Smith, has also pleaded guilty and is awaiting sentencing. Alleged co-conspirator Kyle Nagy remains at large.

title: Robinhood launches Ethereum layer-2 testnet for tokenized assets
summary: Robinhood is testing its own Arbitrum‑based Ethereum layer‑2, deepening its push into tokenized stocks and DeFi infrastructure alongside other major exchanges.

title: Crypto miner Canaan sinks 7% despite strongest quarter in 3 years
summary: Canaan’s fall on Tuesday sent its share price to $0.56, falling further from the $1 it must reclaim by July to avoid a potential Nasdaq delisting.

title: Large demand zone below $2K ETH price gives signal on where Ether may go
summary: ETH’s market structure and fractal analysis from 2021 and 2024 provide insights where significant buy demand may exist. Currently, it’s on the downside.

title: Top Bitcoin traders refuse to turn bullish despite BTC’s 14% rebound: Here’s why
summary: Bitcoin’s double-digit rebound and brief trading above $72,000 may confirm $60,000 was the bottom, but data shows top traders are refusing to open longs.

title: SBF seeks new FTX fraud trial, citing new witness testimony
summary: Sam Bankman-Fried asked a federal appeals panel for a new trial in the FTX fraud case, arguing that new witness testimony could weaken the case that led to his 25-year sentence.

title: State Street warns dollar could fall 10% if Fed cuts more than expected
summary: State Street argues the US dollar could fall to multi-year lows if the Fed cuts rates more aggressively, a scenario that could shift capital toward Bitcoin and risk assets.
